FAQ

Questions about media house software

Short, direct answers.

What is a media workflow management system?

It is software that moves content from idea to publication to payment: calendars, assignments, approvals, assets and billing. Sarvlekh tailors it to your newsroom or studio.

Can it manage freelancers?

Yes. Track rates, deliverables, TDS and payouts for every freelancer.

Can it store large video files?

Yes. We integrate with your preferred storage and keep versions and rights metadata indexed.

Can the media house system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the media house system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
